versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the video-vocal-remover skill for removing human speech from videos while preserving mechanical and environmental sounds.
- Uses ffmpeg equalizer filters to attenuate vocal frequency bands (300Hz–3400Hz), retaining sounds outside this range.
- Provides clear instructions for processing a single file or batch processing folders.
- Includes guidance for parameter tuning to achieve optimal results for different scenarios.
- Clearly distinguishes this skill from full audio removal and AI-based separation methods.
